claim_boundary: Coarse tags are graph-blind trace-sampling metadata only. They are not adequacy labels, motif labels, correctness judgments, or evidence of internal computation.
qualification_claim_boundary: This fresh matched qualification estimates protocol stability and human agreement for refined zero-shot and few-shot prompting. It does not make model votes ground truth, estimate population accuracy, or qualify ADAG, motifs, or witnesses.

tags.active_task_work: The unit performs an operation that creates new task state or evidence, such as calculation, transformation, retrieval, traversal, lookup, comparison, selection, counting, or state update.
tags.evaluation_or_revision: The unit primarily assesses, rejects, validates, corrects, or replaces an already available candidate, result, or state. Merely planning to check is not evaluation.
tags.intermediate_commitment: The unit primarily reports or settles a derived non-final result or state without performing its derivation or evaluation in that same unit.
tags.final_answer: The unit commits or serializes the terminal answer.
tags.other_semantic_text: The unit plans future work, explains, restates, quotes, or comments without creating new task state or evidence.
tags.surface_or_control: The unit carries no proposition by itself and consists only of formatting, punctuation, whitespace/control, tags, or other structural material.
tags.uncertain: Two classifications remain defensible after applying the trajectory-effect rules, or the supplied unit boundary prevents a meaningful decision. Do not force a label.

few_shot_demonstrations.rationale: The incomplete boundary prevents a meaningful exclusive classification; report merge_next as a boundary concern.

few_shot_demonstrations.label: final_answer
few_shot_demonstrations.rationale: Final answer wins over embedded active work, while split_needed records the mixed boundary.

comparison_plan.unit_of_comparison: one of 144 frozen focal units with three votes per arm
required_reporting: retain all individual decisions and full vote histograms
report stability and vote histograms overall and by hidden sampling stratum
report boundary-concern and uncertain rates without treating lower abstention as better
report receipt-derived usage and cost separately by arm
never treat a stable majority as ground truth
comparison_plan.human_evaluation: A fresh blind human holdout review is required for accuracy claims. It records one primary label, optional defensible alternatives, and boundary concerns; all 144 decisions are globally sealed before any model reveal. Human labels and model votes remain separate.

decision_gate.admissibility: reject few-shot if it has more than two additional human process-bearing false negatives than zero-shot
decision_gate.few_shot_improvement: few-shot is improved only with at least five net paired admissible-agreement wins and no increase in stable high-confidence human errors
decision_gate.three_way_votes: a 1-1-1 vote remains disputed and is never resolved by decision precedence
